description: Look at a business card as it is right now: its details, both sides as pictures, a description of each side in words, whether it can still be changed, and its order link. Use it before answering a question about a card you made earlier, because the user can change the card themselves on the site before paying. It changes nothing. Pass the order link returned by create_business_card, or the id in it.

order.description: The order link returned by create_business_card, or the id inside it.

name: get_business_card
title: Look at a business card
